The Incident of Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Umar (RA) when he heard a Verse of the Qur'aan
Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Umar (RA) says, "I brought to mind everything that Allaah had given me when I heard the verse:

blocks.arabic_text: لَنْ تَنَالُوا الْبِرَّ حَتّٰى تُنْفِقُوْا مِمَّا تُحِبُّوْنَ
blocks.text: You shall never reach (true, perfect) righteousness until you spend of that which you love.[^2]

However, I could think of no possession more beloved to me than Marjaana, my Roman slave woman. I then said, 'She is free for the pleasure of Allaah.' If I were to ever go back on something that I had allocated to Allaah, I would have certainly married her."[^3]
Another narration adds that Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Umar (RA) got her married to Hadhrat Naafi and she thus gave birth to his child.[^4]
The Narration of Hadhrat Naafi Concerning the Spending of Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Umar (RA)

Hadhrat Naafi narrates, "Whenever the love of Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Umar (RA) for any of his possessions became intense, he offered it to his Rabb (gave it away as Sadaqah). His slaves knew this well and they would sometimes exert themselves in good deeds and attach themselves to the Masjid. When he saw this excellent behaviour, Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Umar (RA) would then set them free. His companions said to him, 'O Abu Abdur Rahmaan! By Allaah! They are only deceiving you.' He would reply to this by saying, 'We fall for the deceit of anyone who deceives us with acts pleasing to Allaah.'" Hadhrat Naafi continues, "I can recall one evening when Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Umar (RA) was riding an excellent camel for which he had paid a large sum. When he became extremely impressed with the way it carried itself, he made it sit down and then dismounted. He then said, 'O Naafi! First remove its reins and saddle and then put a blanket on it, mark it and include it amongst the sacrificial animals.'"[^5]
